text:
maria: Heads-up: we're seeing a cluster of GPU nodes in eu-west1 with unexpected evictions after the BMC firmware push at 03:12Z. nvme link flaps and the kubelet is marking nodes NotReady -> pod evictions.

jonathan: I see the same in the provisioning dashboard — ~18 GPUs drained across 6 hosts, scheduler rebalanced jobs. latency spike on inference pools.

sre-robin: Initial triage: BMC commit toggled a secure-boot attr on a subset of racks. Some NICs/PCIe devices drop during re-applies causing nvme controller reset.

infra-oncall: paging logs: "PCIe link lost (slot 3): controller reset" across r12-{04,05,06}. Repro on a canary replicate with same fw.

maria: Can we pause the rest of the oob rollout? We haven't rolled to ap-south or us-west yet. Cost of reprovisioning workloads is already visible. :grimacing:

deploy-bot: deployment "bmc-firmware/2026-03-21" status: PAUSED by infra-oncall at 03:45Z.

aisha: +1 pause. Recommend reverting to previous signed image on affected racks and keep a tight canary (single rack) with extra telemetry.

jonathan: What's the rollback plan? runbook suggests remote flash with signed image and soft-reset. ETA?

ops-ethan: Rolling a revert now for r12-04/05. Steps:
```
ssh jump-host
sudo /usr/local/bin/bmc-fw-flash --image s3://firmware/bmc-2026-02-09-signed.bin --rack r12-04 --reboot
watch -n 2 /usr/local/bin/bmc-health --rack r12-04
```

maria: Keep an eye on nvme SMART counters and dmesg for "AER: Corrected PCIe". If link resets persist after revert, we need to power-cycle the host and mark for hardware triage.

sre-robin: Temporary mitigation: adjust kubelet eviction thresholds to 10m grace for kube-system pods in the affected node-pools to reduce churning while we revert. Also bump Reserved GPUs on Dedicated pools to avoid customer-visible alloc churn.

infra-oncall: Noted. I've applied kubelet flag patch to r12 pool and created an autoscaler hold for eu-west1 inference pools.

aisha: Cost note: keeping hold and rebalancing will add ~120 GPU-hours to our monthly overage in eu-west1 if this drags >24h. Ops finance alerted.

jonathan: Also check NTP/PTP on BMCs — we saw a drift yesterday that can cause signed reflashes to be rejected; that could explain partial toggles.

maria: Good catch. ops-ethan, can you run a quick NTP check on affected BMCs and confirm time skew?

ops-ethan: running: `bmcctl ntp-status --rack r12-04,05,06` -> returning offsets ~2.1s, 0.9s, 2.4s. Will force ntp-sync and then re-attempt.

deploy-bot: bump: runbook link -> https://redwood-internal/ops/runbooks/secboot-bmc (private)

sre-robin: After revert, we'll run a stress job for 30m to verify nvme stability and GPU retention. If green, resume rollout with 1-rack canary and 60m observation window.

maria: Postmortem owners: jonathan + aisha. Immediate actions: pause rollout (done), revert affected racks (in progress), autoscaler hold (done), finance ping (done). Will post status update to #incidents in 30m. :thumbsup:
